description: EJScreen: Get EJScreen environmental-justice indicators for a point and surrounding buffer. Returns the 13 EJScreen environmental indicators (PM2.5, ozone, diesel particulate, NO2, lead paint, traffic proximity, Superfund/RMP/hazardous-waste/wastewater proximity, underground storage tanks, drinking-water non-compliance, and RSEI toxic air releases) and 6 demographic indicators (people of color, low income, limited English, less than high school, under 5, over 64), each with national and state percentiles plus EJ Index values, along with the Demographic Index and Supplemental Demographic Index and their national averages. Data is EJAM's ACS 2018–2022 release of EJScreen (EJScreen 2.3 method), served via the community-maintained EJAM API (api.ejanalysis.com, Public Environmental Data Partners), which rehosts EJScreen after EPA discontinued public access in 2025 — not a live EPA endpoint. Provide latitude, longitude, and a buffer distance (default 1 mile, max 15 miles). When EJScreen has no indicators — the point is outside its US bounds, the buffer holds no Census block, or its blocks have no residents — coverage.valid is false and coverage.note says which, and whether a larger distance may help.

distance.description: Buffer radius around the point, in the given unit (default 1). The miles-equivalent must be 15 or less.

unit.description: Unit for distance. Kilometers are converted to miles (× 0.621371) before the request.

name: epa_ejscreen_get_scores

coverage.description: Whether EJScreen data was available for the buffer.

note.description: Present when valid is false: what EJScreen found for the buffer, and whether a larger distance may reach data.

valid.description: True when EJScreen returned indicators for the buffer; false when it has none because the point is outside its US bounds, the buffer holds no Census block, or its blocks have no residents.

dataSource.description: Provenance and vintage of the data.

demographic.description: EJScreen demographic indicators present for the area. Empty when coverage.valid is false.

percent.description: Share of the buffer population, as a percentage (0–100).

demographicIndex.description: EJScreen Demographic Index. Absent when coverage.valid is false.

statePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) of the state-normalized Demographic Index, which is built from z-scores within the state rather than nationally.

usAverage.description: National average of the Demographic Index. Absent when EJScreen did not report it.

usPercentile.description: National percentile (0–100) of the Demographic Index.

value.description: Demographic Index for the buffer: the mean of the national z-scores for percent low income and percent people of color, shifted so the lowest block group scores 0. Unitless; higher means more disadvantaged, and usAverage gives the national average to compare against.

environmental.description: EJScreen environmental indicators present for the area. Empty when coverage.valid is false.

items.description: One environmental indicator with percentiles and its EJ Index.

ejIndex.description: EJ Index: the Demographic Index × this indicator's US percentile, computed per block group and population-weighted over the buffer.

ejIndexStatePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) of the EJ Index.

ejIndexUsPercentile.description: National percentile (0–100) of the EJ Index.

statePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) for the raw value.

unit.description: Unit or scale of the raw value.

usPercentile.description: National percentile (0–100) for the raw value.

value.description: Raw indicator value, in the unit given by the unit field.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `buffer_too_large`: The buffer radius exceeds the EJAM API cap of 15 miles (after converting kilometers to miles). `upstream_rejected`: The EJAM API answered HTTP 400 for a point inside the bounds it accepts, so the lookup failed at EJAM rather than on the coordinates. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

location.description: The queried location and buffer context.

blockGroupCount.description: Number of census block groups intersecting the buffer. Absent when EJScreen found no Census block for the buffer.

bufferMiles.description: Buffer radius in miles used for the query (kilometers inputs converted first).

latitude.description: Latitude of the queried point in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the queried point in decimal degrees.

population.description: Area-weighted population within the buffer; 0 when its blocks have no residents. Absent when EJScreen found no Census block for the buffer.

state.description: 2-letter state abbreviation for the area (e.g. "MD"). Absent when EJScreen found no Census block for the buffer.

stateName.description: Full state name (e.g. "Maryland"). Absent when EJScreen found no Census block for the buffer.

notice.description: The coverage note, repeated as guidance, when no indicators were returned.

reportUrl.description: Link (absolute URL) to the full EJScreen report for this point and buffer.

supplementalDemographicIndex.description: EJScreen Supplemental Demographic Index. Absent when coverage.valid is false.

statePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) of the state-normalized Supplemental Demographic Index, which is built from z-scores within the state rather than nationally.

usAverage.description: National average of the Supplemental Demographic Index. Absent when EJScreen did not report it.

usPercentile.description: National percentile (0–100) of the Supplemental Demographic Index.

value.description: Supplemental Demographic Index for the buffer: the mean of the national z-scores for percent low income, percent limited English, percent less than high school education, percent with disabilities, and low life expectancy (four components when life expectancy is missing), shifted so the lowest block group scores 0. Unitless; higher means more disadvantaged, and usAverage gives the national average to compare against.

title: Get EJScreen Environmental Justice Indicators
